latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Best Text to Video AI.

- Convert text, scripts, or supported files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4 up to 200MB) into AI-generated videos.
- Renders videos on cloud GPUs at 1080p, with typical processing time of 1–2 minutes per request.
- Supports direct file uploads and custom instructions for style, overlays, aspect ratio, or audio.
- Offers simple workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Integrated session and token management for free and registered users, with error handling and real-time status updates.
